## Summary

What changed and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] `(cd ui && npm ci && npm run build)`
- [ ] Tested with a sample library (no personal photos committed)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or private paths in the diff
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / config example / deploy samples) if needed

## Screenshots / logs

For UI changes, include a screenshot. For backend changes, include relevant logs or benchmarks.
